options: The determinant of a matrix of coordinates.
The angle itself in radians.
The sum of the vector coordinates.

questions.explanation: Cauchy-Schwarz states $|\langle x,y\rangle|\le\|x\|\|y\|$, so its left side is the absolute value of the inner product.
